en.template: Help me prepare a household tax check for {year}, {family}, {income}, {salary}, {design}, {nppn}, and {final}. Separate employer TER from the annual family calculation, compare only eligible methods and explain unknowns. Give me questions for a tax adviser and a cash-reserve plan, not a made-up final bill. Do not access accounts, register entities or file anything.

phases.title: Confirm the current tax rules and how they apply to her family and side income
phases.note: Official tax-office, regulation and finance-ministry pages
phases.judgment: It refused to overstate what a new regulation says: the researcher searched the full text of the 2026 amendment, found the word “designer” in it zero times, and noted that nobody should claim designers were expressly added.

phases.title: Run every calculation in code and write the guide and the source log
phases.note: TER withholding, December adjustment, three side-income methods, Coretax steps, penalties, monthly budget
phases.judgment: When two official sources disagreed it said so and showed both: the regulation’s table gives 32% for graphic design in Jakarta while the tax office’s own designer explainer says 46%. The guide uses 32% only as a conditional example, and states the actual bill cannot be calculated without the husband’s income and credits.

phases.title: Independent review of rules and arithmetic, fixes, and desktop and phone layout checks
phases.judgment: A reviewer who had not written the guide recomputed 81 figures, with no discrepancies. Source claims that were wrong or unsupported were repaired and re-read before delivery.

workers: Read the official Indonesian rules on family taxation, the final tax on small-business income and the revenue-norm method for freelancers
Independently recomputed every figure and checked each claim against the official sources
